project.name: treetracker-infrastructure
project.description: Infrastructure-as-code that provisions and operates the Greenstand treetracker platform across DigitalOcean and AWS: Kubernetes clusters, a managed PostgreSQL data tier, API gateway and identity, application and data workloads, observability and operational tooling.

nodes.name: Cloud & Cluster Provisioning
nodes.summary: Provisions the foundational cloud substrate with Terraform: DigitalOcean Kubernetes (DOKS) clusters and node pools, AWS/DigitalOcean IAM access, DNS, the bastion host and remote state backends. Also manages Bitnami Sealed Secrets so credentials live safely in git before workloads deploy.

businessRules: All state stored in S3-compatible DigitalOcean Spaces backends
Node pools segregate microservices, cloud-services and monitoring workloads
Credentials committed to git only as kubeseal-encrypted SealedSecrets
crossDomainInteractions: Provides clusters and secrets consumed by Ingress & Identity, Application & Data Platform and Observability
Establishes network and IAM foundation for the Database Platform

nodes.name: Provision DOKS Cluster
nodes.summary: Terraform provisions a DigitalOcean Kubernetes cluster with dedicated microservices, cloud-services and monitoring node pools per environment.

nodes.name: Configure provider & backend
nodes.summary: Declare the DigitalOcean and Kubernetes providers and the Spaces remote state backend for the environment.

nodes.name: Set cluster variables
nodes.summary: Supply cluster name and backend bucket via environment tfvars files.

nodes.name: Define cluster & node pools
nodes.summary: Declare the DOKS cluster plus autoscaling microservices, cloud-services and monitoring node pools.

nodes.name: Apply Terraform
nodes.summary: Run terraform apply to create the cluster and register its kubeconfig for downstream workloads.

nodes.name: Provision Cloud Access, DNS & Bastion
nodes.summary: Terraform provisions scoped AWS/DigitalOcean IAM users and access keys, DNS records and the bastion host used to reach private resources.

nodes.name: Define IAM users & policies
nodes.summary: Provision scoped AWS IAM users, access keys and inline policies for services such as CloudFront and backups.

nodes.name: Provision DNS records
nodes.summary: Create DigitalOcean domain and CNAME records that alias service hosts to the cluster ingress.

nodes.name: Deploy bastion host
nodes.summary: Instantiate the external terraform-digitalocean-bastion module for secure access to private resources.

nodes.name: Configure remote state
nodes.summary: Store bastion and access Terraform state in the S3-compatible Spaces backend.

nodes.name: Manage Sealed Secrets
nodes.summary: Encrypts Kubernetes credentials with kubeseal so they can be committed to git, and deploys the Sealed Secrets controller and web UI.

nodes.name: Seal a secret
nodes.summary: Encrypt a plain Kubernetes secret into a SealedSecret with kubeseal for safe storage in git.

nodes.name: Seal database connection secret
nodes.summary: Build the service database URI and seal it as the database-connection secret.

nodes.name: Deploy Sealed Secrets web UI
nodes.summary: Ansible playbook deploys the sealed-secrets web UI to manage encrypted secrets.

nodes.name: Database Platform
nodes.summary: Provisions and governs the managed PostgreSQL data tier for the treetracker microservices: the DigitalOcean managed cluster with read replica, per-microservice schemas with least-privilege role grants, pgpool routing and S3 backup storage.

businessRules: Fifteen per-microservice schemas each instantiated from the shared microservice_schema module
Roles receive least-privilege grants and default privileges per schema
Firewall rules restrict database access to trusted sources
crossDomainInteractions: Supplies the keycloak schema consumed by Ingress & Identity
Backs Airflow, CKAN and other services in the Application & Data Platform
Relies on Cloud & Cluster Provisioning for network and IAM foundation

nodes.name: Provision Managed Postgres
nodes.summary: Terraform provisions the DigitalOcean managed PostgreSQL cluster, its databases, read replica and firewall rules.

nodes.name: Declare provider
nodes.summary: Configure the DigitalOcean provider and do_token authentication for the database stack.

nodes.name: Define Postgres cluster
nodes.summary: Declare the DigitalOcean managed PostgreSQL 11 cluster (2 nodes) serving as the production database.

nodes.name: Define databases
nodes.summary: Create per-service databases such as ckan within the managed cluster.

nodes.name: Provision Schema & Grants
nodes.summary: Fans out to per-microservice schemas via the reusable microservice_schema module, creating roles and least-privilege table and default privilege grants.

nodes.name: Invoke schema module
nodes.summary: The prod root module fans out to fifteen per-microservice schemas through the microservice_schema submodule.

nodes.name: Create schema & role
nodes.summary: The microservice_schema module provisions a schema and its owning service role.

nodes.name: Grant table privileges
nodes.summary: Grant SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on schema tables to the service role, e.g. s_keycloak.

nodes.name: Create read-only user
nodes.summary: Provision a cross-schema read-only role for reporting and analytics access.

nodes.name: Database Backup Storage
nodes.summary: Provisions the backup IAM user and S3-compatible bucket used to store managed PostgreSQL backups.

nodes.name: Provision backup IAM user
nodes.summary: Create the database-backups IAM user with an access key and S3 backup policy.

nodes.name: Provision backup bucket
nodes.summary: Provision the production backups storage bucket for PostgreSQL dumps.

nodes.name: Ingress & Identity
nodes.summary: Exposes backend services through the Ambassador API gateway and authenticates users with the Keycloak identity provider. Ambassador is the single ingress fronting every service; Keycloak runs a custom-themed image with realm and client configuration.

businessRules: Ambassador is the single ingress fronting every backend service
Keycloak credentials injected from SealedSecrets and stored in the keycloak Postgres schema
Service routes declared as Ambassador Mapping custom resources
crossDomainInteractions: Routes traffic to services in the Application & Data Platform
Uses the keycloak schema from the Database Platform
Depends on clusters and secrets from Cloud & Cluster Provisioning

nodes.name: Deploy API Gateway
nodes.summary: Installs the Ambassador API gateway via an Ansible/Helm playbook, provisions its DNS and applies service Mappings.

nodes.name: Run Ambassador playbook
nodes.summary: Ansible playbook installs the Ambassador operator against the local cluster.

nodes.name: Install via Helm
nodes.summary: The ambassador role adds the Helm repo and installs the Ambassador API gateway chart.

nodes.name: Provision gateway DNS
nodes.summary: Terraform provisions the ambassador host domain and www CNAME record.

nodes.name: Apply service Mappings
nodes.summary: Apply Ambassador Mapping resources that route HTTP prefixes to backend services.

nodes.name: Deploy Keycloak Identity
nodes.summary: Builds the custom-themed Keycloak image and deploys it to Kubernetes with a Kustomize overlay, sealed credentials and an Ambassador route.

nodes.name: Build custom Keycloak image
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Dockerfile bakes the treetracker theme onto the Keycloak 23.0 image with health and metrics enabled.

nodes.name: Apply base deployment
nodes.summary: Kubernetes Deployment wires the Keycloak server to Postgres and admin credentials from secrets.

nodes.name: Apply production overlay
nodes.summary: Kustomize production overlay layers the sealed-secret and environment patches onto the base.

nodes.name: Route /keycloak mapping
nodes.summary: Ambassador Mapping routes the /keycloak/ prefix to the keycloak-service on port 8080.

nodes.name: Run deploy script
nodes.summary: Interactive deploy script validates the kubectl context and applies the selected environment overlay.

nodes.name: Application & Data Platform
nodes.summary: Deploys the higher-level application workloads on the cluster: RabbitMQ messaging, Airflow workflow orchestration, the Solr/CKAN/OpenProject data platform and the S3-backed static web apps with CDN delivery.

businessRules: Async service communication runs on a 3-replica RabbitMQ cluster
Airflow and CKAN connect to the managed PostgreSQL databases
Static sites are S3-backed and fronted by CloudFront
crossDomainInteractions: Consumes databases from the Database Platform
Runs on clusters from Cloud & Cluster Provisioning

nodes.name: Deploy Messaging (RabbitMQ)
nodes.summary: Deploys a 3-replica RabbitmqCluster via the RabbitMQ Operator using Kustomize overlays per environment.

nodes.name: Install RabbitMQ operator
nodes.summary: Install the RabbitMQ Operator into Kubernetes via the Helm chart and Ansible.

nodes.name: Define RabbitmqCluster
nodes.summary: RabbitmqCluster custom resource defines a 3-replica broker with fixed CPU/memory limits.

nodes.name: Apply environment overlay
nodes.summary: Kustomize overlay references the shared base for the target environment.

nodes.name: Deploy to cluster
nodes.summary: Deploy script switches kubectl context and applies the RabbitMQ kustomization.

nodes.name: Deploy Workflow Orchestration (Airflow)
nodes.summary: Installs Airflow on the DOKS cluster via an Ansible-driven Helm chart with per-environment Postgres connection settings.

nodes.name: Run Airflow playbook
nodes.summary: Ansible playbook installs Airflow by applying the airflow role against localhost.

nodes.name: Configure group_vars
nodes.summary: Set Postgres connection, base URL and deployment branch in the environment group_vars.

nodes.name: Set inventory
nodes.summary: Ansible inventory targets the local host for the environment deployment.

nodes.name: Deploy Data Platform (Solr/CKAN/OpenProject)
nodes.summary: Deploys the Solr search engine, CKAN open-data portal and OpenProject onto the cluster with external Postgres wiring.

nodes.name: Deploy Solr
nodes.summary: Helm release deploys the Apache Solr chart into the solr namespace via Terraform.

nodes.name: Wire CKAN database
nodes.summary: Endpoints manifest maps the ckan-postgres service to the external managed PostgreSQL instance.

nodes.name: Deploy OpenProject
nodes.summary: Apply the namespace, deployment, service and ingress manifests that run OpenProject.

nodes.name: Deploy Static Web Apps & CDN
nodes.summary: Provisions S3-backed static front-end sites (web map, wallet, admin panels) across environments and the CDN images API via Terraform.

nodes.name: Provision web map site
nodes.summary: Deploy the production web map static site with S3 redirect routing rules.

nodes.name: Provision wallet & admin sites
nodes.summary: Provision the wallet and admin panel static sites via the shared Greenstand static website module.

nodes.name: Provision CDN images API
nodes.summary: Provision the cdn-images-api CloudFront delivery configuration.

nodes.name: Observability & Alerting
nodes.summary: Observes the platform with a Prometheus/Grafana metrics stack, Loki log aggregation and Jaeger distributed tracing, all installed via Ansible playbooks, plus Botkube chat-ops alerting.

businessRules: Metrics, logs and traces installed via Ansible-driven Helm charts
Ambassador emits zipkin-format traces to the Jaeger collector
node_exporter runs on all server hosts
crossDomainInteractions: Configures tracing on the Ambassador gateway in Ingress & Identity
Monitors workloads across the Application & Data Platform
Runs on the monitoring node pool from Cloud & Cluster Provisioning

nodes.name: Deploy Metrics Stack
nodes.summary: Installs the kube-prometheus-stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager) and node_exporter via Ansible.

nodes.name: Run Prometheus playbook
nodes.summary: Ansible playbook installs the Prometheus Operator via the prometheus_operator role.

nodes.name: Configure stack values
nodes.summary: Helm values configure Prometheus, Grafana and Alertmanager for the kube-prometheus-stack.

nodes.name: Install node exporter
nodes.summary: Ansible playbook installs Prometheus node_exporter on all server hosts.

nodes.name: Deploy Logging (Loki)
nodes.summary: Installs the Loki logging stack with Promtail and Fluent-bit via Ansible and Helm.

nodes.name: Install Loki stack
nodes.summary: Ansible role adds the Loki Helm repository and installs the loki-stack chart.

nodes.name: Configure Loki values
nodes.summary: Helm values configure Loki, Promtail and Fluent-bit for log collection.

nodes.name: Deploy Tracing (Jaeger)
nodes.summary: Deploys Jaeger distributed tracing and wires the Ambassador gateway to emit zipkin traces.

nodes.name: Deploy Jaeger
nodes.summary: Deploy the Jaeger distributed tracing backend via the tracing Ansible playbooks.

nodes.name: Configure TracingService
nodes.summary: Ambassador TracingService sends zipkin-format traces to the jaeger-collector.

nodes.name: Restart Ambassador
nodes.summary: Ansible role adds the tracing plugin and triggers a rolling restart of the ambassador deployment.

nodes.name: Platform Operations & CI
nodes.summary: Day-to-day operations and continuous integration: shell scripts to authenticate to the DOKS clusters, provision tooling and export credentials, plus pre-commit and GitHub Actions CI that enforce Terraform formatting.

businessRules: Operators authenticate to each DOKS cluster with doctl and helm
terraform_fmt runs on every commit via pre-commit
CI runs pre-commit on pull requests and pushes to master
crossDomainInteractions: Enables credentials and cluster access for Cloud & Cluster Provisioning
Validates Terraform across all provisioning domains

nodes.name: Cluster Access Setup
nodes.summary: Operator scripts authenticate to DigitalOcean, save the kubeconfig for a target cluster and install required tooling.

nodes.name: Export DO credentials
nodes.summary: Export production DigitalOcean credentials from ~/.netrc into AWS-style environment variables.

nodes.name: Authenticate doctl
nodes.summary: Authenticate to DigitalOcean and save the kubeconfig for a named Kubernetes cluster.

nodes.name: Install tooling
nodes.summary: Provision the host with Ansible, Docker, Helm 3 and the community.kubernetes collection.

nodes.name: CI Validation
nodes.summary: Pre-commit and GitHub Actions enforce Terraform formatting on commits and pull requests.

nodes.name: Configure pre-commit hooks
nodes.summary: Pre-commit config runs the terraform_fmt hook on every commit.

nodes.name: Run CI workflow
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions runs pre-commit hooks on pull requests and pushes to master with Terraform setup.

edges.description: Provides the network and IAM foundation the managed Postgres tier depends on
Provides the DOKS cluster and sealed secrets that host the gateway and Keycloak
Provides the cluster and node pools that run application workloads
Provides the dedicated monitoring node pool for the observability stack
Supplies the keycloak schema and role that back the identity provider
Backs Airflow, CKAN and other services with managed Postgres databases
Ambassador routes external HTTP traffic to application and data services
Configures the Ambassador gateway to emit distributed traces to Jaeger
Operator scripts and CI supply credentials and validate the provisioning Terraform
